response.sql: SELECT AVG(TG) AS avg_TG, AVG(WBC) AS avg_WBC FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC > 6.5

assumptions.assumption: AVG(TG) ignores rows where TG is NULL, so it averages only the records with a TG value. AVG(WBC) averages all records with WBC > 6.5, including those where TG is NULL.

alternatives.interpretation: Average both columns over the same set of rows, meaning only records with WBC > 6.5 that also have a non-missing TG.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(TG) AS avg_TG, AVG(WBC) AS avg_WBC FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC > 6.5 AND TG IS NOT NULL

alternatives.interpretation: Average both columns over the same set of rows, meaning only records with WBC > 6.5 that also have a non-missing TG.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(TG) AS avg_TG, AVG(WBC) AS avg_WBC FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC > 6.5 AND TG IS NOT NULL
